tokens.name: ground-window
tokens.usage: Classic's panel: the window ground beside the photograph in the regular editor (Apple `Numa.window`; Linux `.adjustment` uses @window_bg_color). Dark #242424 is Theme.swift's copy of libadwaita's older dark window; libadwaita 1.9 on Linux now draws #222226, which Linux follows automatically. Light #fafafb is libadwaita 1.9's light window (Linux light scheme).

tokens.name: ground-view
tokens.usage: View ground: lists and the library grid (libadwaita view_bg; Apple `Numa.view`). Linux 1.9 dark is #1d1d20. Light #ffffff is libadwaita's light view.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Raised ground: a stand-in print while no thumbnail exists, cards (Apple `Numa.raised`). Light #ffffff is libadwaita's light card_bg (chosen).

tokens.name: ground-sheet
tokens.usage: The iPhone editor's sheet and the sheets it opens (Apple `Numa.sheet`), radius-sheet on top. Light #f3f3f5 chosen from libadwaita's light sidebar ground; no light sheet exists in the sources.

tokens.name: ground-page
tokens.usage: Every page on the iPhone and the iPad: Libraries, a library's grid (Apple `Numa.page`). Also the dark text on a white accent (see on-accent). Light chosen: #ffffff.

tokens.name: ground-photo
tokens.usage: Behind the photograph, in every editor: iPhone, Classic and Modern (Apple `Numa.photo`). Stays black in the light theme too, because photographs are judged against a dark surround; Linux light currently draws darker(@window_bg_color) behind the canvas.

tokens.name: ground-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, command buttons and round buttons at rest (Apple `Numa.chip`: ChipStyle, CommandStyle, RoundStyle). Light #e8e8e8 chosen. `label` fails 4.5:1 here; chip text is white.

tokens.name: ground-hud
tokens.usage: Modern's floating panels and the value HUD: #141414 at 55% over a thin material (Apple `Numa.hud`), a 12px backdrop blur on the web. Lowered from 0.78 at the photographer's request in build 31: "van mij mag het ook wat lager, zichtbaarheid is wel heel belangrijk" — visibility still comes first, so the material does the reading work and text over it is `name` or white, not `label`. Same in both themes: it sits on the photograph.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, and a touched slider's name and value (Linux `.touched`, Apple `.white`). Dark: 15.5:1 on ground-window, 17.2:1 on ground-sheet. Light: libadwaita's window_fg (renders #323237 on ground-window, 12:1).

tokens.name: name
tokens.usage: A slider's name at rest (Linux `.slider-name`, Apple `Numa.name`), secondary buttons like Cancel. Dark: 8.3:1 on ground-window, 9.2:1 on ground-sheet, 7.0:1 on ground-raised. Light #3d3d3d chosen (10.4:1 on ground-window); the Linux light scheme still paints #bdbdbd, which fails there.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Section labels, a value at rest, captions and meta lines (Linux `.section-header`/`.slider-value`, Apple `Numa.label`). Dark passes on ground-window 4.7:1, ground-view 5.0, ground-sheet 5.2, ground-page 5.6, ground-photo 5.8. FAILS on ground-raised (3.98:1) and ground-chip (4.32:1): never set label text on those; over the photograph (ground-hud) use `name` instead (SectionLabel's colour there). Light #636363 chosen (5.8:1 ground-window, 5.4 ground-sheet, 4.9 ground-chip); the Linux light scheme paints #8d8d8d, 3.2:1 on its window, a failing source pair.

tokens.name: tab-rest
tokens.usage: Retired on Apple: an unchosen tab is now `name` on every Apple variant (the chosen one `accent`/`on-accent`). Was the iPhone prototype's #7a7a7a, which FAILS as 10px text (4.0:1 on ground-sheet); kept for the record.

tokens.name: rail-rest
tokens.usage: An unselected Linux rail tab (`button.rail-tab`). 5.5:1 on ground-window.

tokens.name: intro-word
tokens.usage: The wordmark 'numa' in the eclipse intro (prototype #e8e8e8; PhoneIntro white 0.91). 15:1 on the intro ground.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline between panel and photograph and under bars (Linux alpha(currentColor, 0.1), Apple `Numa.rule`). Light: the same 10% of ink.

tokens.name: rule-sheet
tokens.usage: The line above the iPhone's tab row (PhoneEditor).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The slider's 2px hairline track, at rest and touched alike (Linux `.adjustment scale trough`, Apple, both prototypes). Light: 11% of ink, chosen.

tokens.name: track-hover
tokens.usage: The Linux track under a pointer (`.quiet scale:hover trough`). No hover on touch.

tokens.name: thumb-rest
tokens.usage: The slider's dot on its neutral: 0.28 on every device, iPhone (dot 14) included (SliderLook.restDot; Linux `.quiet scale slider`).

tokens.name: rest-tick
tokens.usage: The 1x8 tick marking a moved slider's rest (NumaSlider).

tokens.name: select-fill
tokens.usage: A quiet chosen segment in a Linux panel (`.aspect-ratios button:checked`) with ink text at 600. Where a choice must be unmistakable use accent instead. Light chosen.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Numa's accent: white, as the mark (Apple `Numa.accent`). A chosen chip or tab, a prominent command (Done), a round button that is on, held Before, pick flag, set stars, a moved slider's fill and dot, focus ring. Replaces libadwaita blue #3584e4, retired as Numa's accent. Light theme: inverted to ground-page's #141414 (chosen) since white cannot show on white; still monochrome.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill: a chosen chip or tab, Done, an on round button, a held Before (Apple `Numa.onAccent`, #141414). 18.4:1 on accent in both themes.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: A rejected frame: its cross, its stars, the reject flag's fill (Linux `.rejected`, Apple `Numa.reject`). Dark: 6.1:1 on ground-window, 7.6 on ground-photo, 5.2 on ground-raised. Light #c01c28 chosen (GNOME palette Red 4, 5.9:1 on ground-window); #ff7a66 on a light ground is 2.5:1 and fails.

tokens.name: reject-on-photo
tokens.usage: A reject mark on the small black badge over a filmstrip frame (Linux `.strip-badge.rejected`).

tokens.name: star-rest
tokens.usage: An unset star's outline on the iPhone's photograph (prototype #5e5e5e). FAILS 3:1 for a meaningful icon: 2.98:1 on ground-photo. Kept exact; flagged.

tokens.name: mask-wash
tokens.usage: The red wash over what a mask covers, times the mask's strength (Linux masks.rs: rgb 0.95 0.3 0.3 at 0.4). Same in both themes: it is painted on the photograph, and must be a colour no photograph is. Apple's ffi draws rgb(230,40,40) at 0.6 and the iPhone prototype rgba(255,64,64,0.30); this token is the one to converge on.

tokens.name: mask-erase
tokens.usage: A brush stroke that rubs a mask out (Linux draw_stroke).

tokens.name: clip-shadow
tokens.usage: The histogram's clipped-shadows light (Linux `.clip-shadow`). A signal colour, not an accent.

tokens.name: clip-highlight
tokens.usage: The histogram's clipped-highlights light (Linux `.clip-highlight`).

families.system: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "Adwaita Sans", Cantarell, system-ui, sans-serif
families.apple: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The platform's own face: SF Pro on Apple, Adwaita Sans (Cantarell before libadwaita 1.7) on Linux. Sizes in px/pt from the sources; line heights are not set in any source and were chosen here.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: A page's title: Libraries, a library's name (iPhone prototype h1 32/700; SwiftUI's .large navigation title on device). Line height chosen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A shelf's heading (PhoneLibraries 'Folders' 20 bold). Line height chosen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A print stack's name, a HUD-less row's name on iPad rails (15). Line height chosen.

styles.name: bar
styles.usage: Bar buttons on iPhone: Cancel, Done (Done at 600). Line height chosen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Explanations and empty states in label colour (PhoneLibraries 13). Line height chosen.
styles.sample: A folder of photographs from Files, RAW files too, as a library of its own.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip and pill labels, Linux panel-action and PillStyle (13 semibold). Line height = the chip's 32px height.

styles.name: slider-name
styles.usage: A slider's name; the section's lead at 600 (Linux `.slider-name`, NumaSlider). Line height chosen.

styles.name: slider-value
styles.usage: A slider's readout, always tabular figures (`tnum` / .monospacedDigit()) so it does not jitter while dragging.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: The small grey spaced section label, uppercase (Linux `.section-header`, SwiftUI SectionLabel: 10, semibold, tracking 1.1). Line height chosen.

styles.name: hud-name
styles.usage: The HUD's name, uppercase, in label (iPad prototype 12/600/+1.1).

styles.name: hud-value
styles.usage: The HUD's number, light, tabular (iPad prototype 26/300). The wheel's dial uses 30/300.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A stack's caption, tabular (PhoneLibraries 12 monospaced digits).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: A photograph's EXIF line and star badges on thumbnails (11).

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Under a tab icon (iPhone tab row 10, Linux `.rail-label` 10; iPad rail 10.5/600).

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk (Google Fonts, SIL OFL 1.1), used only for the word 'numa' in lowercase, wide-tracked, at 300. Jost until 27 September 2026.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The word 'numa' under the mark in the eclipse intro: 0.38em tracking at rest, drawing in from 0.9em (prototype). Lowercase always. Hanken Grotesk 300, as PhoneIntro.swift sets it (the variable file bundled, wght 300).

spacing.note: Values from the sources; Numa does not keep a strict grid (5px stays 5px).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The iPhone photo grid's gap (three columns, 2px).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between rail tabs (Linux), the thumb margin math, small nudges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Library card padding on Linux (`.photo-rows > box`), flag buttons apart.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row; the rail's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Toolbar row horizontal padding (Linux).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a print stack and its name; loupe padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: A chip's horizontal padding (ChipStyle); a section label's space above (prototype 14px).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bar and chip-row side inset on iPhone.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Column gap between print stacks (two to a row).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page gutter on iPhone; the sheet's slider inset.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Row gap between print stacks; between shelves.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target on iPhone and iPad (Apple HIG; every button in the prototypes). Also the gap between the mark and the word in the intro.

tokens.name: slider-row
tokens.usage: A slider row's minimum height, every platform (Linux `.slider-row`, NumaSlider).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The one outer margin: every element at a screen edge (Modern's corner bar, rail, strip, bottom row; floating controls) sits this far from the edge, or the safe inset if larger. The photographer: 'goed plan van je 16pt'.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Between neighbouring floating elements (Modern's cards and the strip, the round buttons of a row).

radius.note: Photographs keep small corners; controls round off; nothing is square except the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: The 2px slider track and its fill.

tokens.name: radius-histogram
tokens.usage: The histogram and tone curve wells on Linux (Apple uses 6).

tokens.name: radius-print
tokens.usage: A print in a stack, a thumbnail, a preset card, a face (Linux `.thumbnail`, PhoneStackLook).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Linux-style segmented rows. Apple's command button (CommandStyle, formerly PillStyle) is a capsule now, not this radius.

tokens.name: radius-action
tokens.usage: A panel action button (Linux `.panel-action`), the mask scope line.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Library cards on Linux and the Linux rail tab.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: A 32px chip, Before on iPhone: half its height, a capsule.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The iPhone editor sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-hud
tokens.usage: The floating value HUD and 44px round buttons (undo, flags).

shadow.note: Only prints and the intro's light cast shadows; controls are flat (UX-014 took the handle shadow away).

tokens.name: shadow-print-front
tokens.usage: The front print of a stack (prototype; Swift radius 10, y 8, black 0.6).

tokens.name: shadow-print-back
tokens.usage: The two prints behind it (Swift radius 8, y 6, black 0.55).

tokens.name: shadow-intro-glow
tokens.usage: The light disc's glow at its peak in the intro (35% of the glow).

tokens.name: shadow-intro-rest
tokens.usage: The light disc's glow settled, the last frame of the intro and its reduced-motion frame.

tokens.name: shadow-badge
tokens.usage: Star text over a thumbnail (prototype text-shadow).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus in Numa's own content: a solid 2px accent ring 2px out (prototypes: outline 2px #fff, offset 2px). Chrome uses the platform's own focus ring.

size.note: Fixed sizes that make the signatures recognisable.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: The slider's hairline track and its fill.

tokens.name: dot-panel
tokens.usage: The slider dot on Linux and iPad (SliderLook.dot 10).

tokens.name: dot-phone
tokens.usage: The slider dot on iPhone (14, monochrome).

tokens.name: tick-rest
tokens.usage: Height of the 1px rest tick on a moved slider.

tokens.name: print-width
tokens.usage: One print in a stack (118 x 104).

tokens.name: print-height
tokens.usage: One print in a stack.

tokens.name: stack-width
tokens.usage: A stack's box (140 x 124) with three prints turned -8, 6 and 0 degrees.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: A chip, Before on iPhone.

tokens.name: rail-tab

tokens.name: mark-intro
tokens.usage: The light disc in the intro (the dark one is 136).

tokens.name: mark-bar

tokens.name: quiet-value

tokens.name: print-back
tokens.usage: Brightness of the back print.

tokens.usage: A chip while pressed (ChipStyle).
